purpose: Give external agents enough public Git context to propose a Stage-B Rust/Inari interval backend for the current gap-period basis blocker.
current_blocker: Stage B cannot produce directed interval certificates because the required Rust/Inari backend does not exist.

included_material.private_route_artifacts: Sanitized current packet receipts for the basis interval certificate, conditioning gate, gap-period vector contract, boundary-near atom classification, and endpoint/source-kernel scaffold.
included_material.runner_source: Python runner sources for the Stage-A and Stage-B basis packets.
included_material.backend_source: Cargo files and current Rust lib surface.
included_material.reference_backends: Existing Rust/Inari backend patterns used by related #1038 packets.

explicit_exclusions: local absolute filesystem paths, replaced with <H2_MATH_REPO>
bulk build artifacts such as target/ and __pycache__
unrelated #1038 packet forest not needed for the current blocker
